- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Adds `--moe-ep-chunk-overlap` (default **off**): a token-chunked, two-stream schedule that overlaps the MoE expert-parallel all-to-alls with the expert GEMMs, replacing the routed-expert region (dispatch → FC1/act/FC2 → combine) rather than wrapping the existing token dispatcher.

:warning: This is a sizeable addition (**+1452 / −9** over 9 files). Happy to open a design issue first if @NVIDIA/mcore-oncall would prefer that — flagging it proactively per the note above.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: <!-- TODO: open a feature request and link it here; this is a new feature from an open-source contributor, so a linked issue is required -->

---

## Design

The flag is off by default and gated behind a narrow support envelope. When on, `MoELayer` routes the routed-expert region through `MoEEPChunkOverlapRuntime` instead of the flex token dispatcher:

```
forward  (ascending)   FC1(c) → FC2(c)   ||   Dispatch(c+1) or Combine(c−1)
backward (descending)  dgrad(c)          ||   Dispatch(c−1) or Combine(c+1)
                       wgrad(c)          ||   Combine(c)
```

Compute stays on the caller's ambient stream; a single comm stream carries both collectives. Every cross-stream edge is an explicit `torch.cuda.Event`. Weight gradients park in TE's per-op `WeightGradStore` (`delay_wgrad_compute=True`) and are drained inside the loop, so each chunk's wgrad runs under its own chunk's combine.

### New surface

| flag | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--moe-ep-chunk-overlap` | `False` | enable the path |
| `--moe-ep-chunk-overlap-num-chunks` | `4` | source-token chunks per microbatch |
| `--moe-ep-chunk-overlap-num-comm-sms` | `32` | SM budget for the comm stream |

Transport is selected from the **existing** `moe_flex_dispatcher_backend` (`hybridep` / `ncclep`) rather than a new flag. Public API is one name, `MoEEPChunkOverlapRuntime`.

### Files

| file | change |
|---|---|
| `moe/moe_ep_chunk_overlap/` (5 new files) | the runtime, the transport ABC, and the HybridEP / NCCL-EP transports |
| `moe/fused_a2a.py` | **+122 / −0** — purely additive: `make_hybrid_ep_buffer` and two shape-named stateless legs `hybrid_ep_dispatch_leg` / `hybrid_ep_combine_leg`. No existing trunk body is modified; the flex dispatcher's call sites are untouched. |
| `moe/moe_layer.py` | +96 / −4 — construct the runtime, route preprocess/expert/postprocess, envelope refusals |
| `transformer_config.py` | +19 — the three fields above |
| `transformer_layer.py` | +4 / −1 — `MoETransformerLayer` reads `cudagraph_attrs` with a default, since a dispatcher that never ran has not created them |

### Support envelope (refused, loudly, at construction or per-forward)

`expert_tensor_parallel_size=1`, `context_parallel_size=1`, `moe_router_dtype=fp32`, `add_bias_linear=False`, `moe_apply_probs_on_input=False`, MXFP8 (`fp8_recipe=mxfp8`, `first_last_layers_bf16=False`), activation ∈ {gated silu/quick_gelu, ungated squared_relu}, `moe_paged_stash=False`, `overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm=False`, `padding_mask=None`. `recompute_granularity='full'` and `'moe' in recompute_modules` are refused because TE's `WeightGradStore` is a FIFO with no chunk identity and a re-run forward reorders it silently. `'moe_act'` **is** supported. Expert GTP weight remat is supported at ≥ 2 local experts.

---

## Testing — what was actually measured

All on 8× B300 (sm_103), torch 2.11.0+cu130, TE 2.18/2.20, HybridEP, MXFP8, world 2–4, against this branch rebased onto `main` @ `79097b457`.

| check | result |
|---|---|
| routed-expert branch live (real `GPTModel`, fwd+bwd) | **PASS** — 482/3072 routing probs nonzero, **8/8 expert wgrads alive**, `max\|main_grad\| 1.39e-04` |
| same probe with a seeded fault | **FAIL** as required — 0/3072, 0/8 — so the check demonstrably detects |
| selective recompute (`moe_act`, ungated squared_relu) | **PASS**, 4/4 chunks, 8/8 wgrads alive |
| fine-grained activation offloading (`fused_group_mlp`) | **PASS**, 4/4 chunks, 8/8 wgrads alive |
| full-iteration CUDA graphs, no EGTP, vs eager | **96/96 bitwise** (4 ranks × 3 series × 8 iters) |
| partial CUDA graphs, ± EGTP, vs eager | **96/96 bitwise** each |

The liveness check is an **absolute magnitude** assertion, not a differential, deliberately: an earlier defect on this path zeroed every routing probability and the loss curve was indistinguishable from healthy (`6.968` vs `6.975`). A loss gate would not have caught it.

---

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [ ] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel … determinism test
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code
- [x] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

**Unticked boxes, explained rather than glossed:**

- **Unit tests** — a suite exists locally (~90 tests covering the transport seam, the envelope refusals, the EGTP flush and an activation-offload round trip) but is **not in this PR**. It needs porting into `tests/unit_tests/transformer/moe/` and will follow.
- **Functional tests** — none. No recipe references the flag yet.
- **Determinism test** — this PR adds no GPU kernel; it schedules existing TE ops and EP collectives. Happy to add one if reviewers disagree with that reading.
- **autoformat** — currently **red**, and I would rather say so than tick it: two lines exceed the 100-column limit (`moe_layer.py:362`, `:832` → pylint `C0301`) and there is trailing whitespace in `transformer_config.py` and `transformer_layer.py` that `black` will rewrite. Will be clean before this leaves draft.

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""The token-chunked EP overlap path: parameters, TE grouped MLP, schedule.
+
+Compute is the caller's current stream; dispatch and combine share ONE comm stream.
+Chunk ``c``'s compute is left of the ``||``::
+
+    forward   (ascending)    FC1(c) -> FC2(c)   ||   Dispatch(c+1) or Combine(c-1)
+    backward  (descending)   dgrad(c)           ||   Dispatch(c-1) or Combine(c+1)
+                             wgrad(c)           ||   Combine(c)
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from itertools import chain
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch.autograd.function import once_differentiable
+
+from megatron.core.activations import squared_relu
+from megatron.core.fusions.fused_bias_geglu import quick_gelu
+from megatron.core.pipeline_parallel.fine_grained_activation_offload import (
+    FineGrainedActivationOffloadingInterface as off_interface,
+)
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.gtp_api import is_gtp_param
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+
+from .transport import DispatchedChunk, MoEEPTransport, MoEEPTransportType, make_ep_transport
+
+EXPERT_ALIGNMENT_TO_GROUPED_GEMM = 256
+
+
+def balanced_chunk_sizes(num_tokens: int, num_chunks: int) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    base, remainder = divmod(num_tokens, num_chunks)
+    return tuple(base + (1 if index < remainder else 0) for index in range(num_chunks))
+
+
+def chunk_offsets(chunk_sizes: tuple[int, ...]) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    offsets = [0]
+    for size in chunk_sizes:
+        offsets.append(offsets[-1] + size)
+    return tuple(offsets)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _MoEEPChunkOverlapConfig:
+    num_local_tokens: int
+    hidden_size: int
+    ffn_hidden_size: int
+    num_experts: int
+    router_topk: int
+    num_token_chunks: int
+    world_size: int
+    num_comm_SMs: int
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.num_token_chunks < 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"num_token_chunks must be >= 1, got {self.num_token_chunks}")
+        if self.num_local_tokens < self.num_token_chunks:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"num_local_tokens ({self.num_local_tokens}) must be >= num_token_chunks "
+                f"({self.num_token_chunks}); an empty chunk is not a supported dispatch shape"
+            )
+
+    @property
+    def chunk_sizes(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        return balanced_chunk_sizes(self.num_local_tokens, self.num_token_chunks)
+
+    @property
+    def chunk_offsets(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        return chunk_offsets(self.chunk_sizes)
+
+    @property
+    def largest_token_chunk_size(self) -> int:
+        return -(-self.num_local_tokens // self.num_token_chunks)
+
+    @property
+    def num_local_experts(self) -> int:
+        return self.num_experts // self.world_size
+
+    @property
+    def max_num_expanded_tokens_per_chunk(self) -> int:
+        num_local_experts = self.num_local_experts
+        rows = self.world_size * self.largest_token_chunk_size * min(
+            self.router_topk, num_local_experts
+        ) + num_local_experts * (EXPERT_ALIGNMENT_TO_GROUPED_GEMM - 1)
+        return -(-rows // EXPERT_ALIGNMENT_TO_GROUPED_GEMM) * EXPERT_ALIGNMENT_TO_GROUPED_GEMM
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class CachedForwardChunkActivation:
+    dispatched_tokens: torch.Tensor
+    routing_probs: torch.Tensor
+    fc2_output: torch.Tensor
+    dispatch_handle: object
+
+
+def ensure_expert_parameters_ready(experts: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Fire the expert linears' forward-pre hooks; skipping silently desyncs the DP all-gather."""
+    for submodule in chain(experts.linear_fc1.modules(), experts.linear_fc2.modules()):
+        for hook_id, hook in list(submodule._forward_pre_hooks.items()):
+            if hook_id in submodule._forward_pre_hooks_with_kwargs:
+                returned = hook(submodule, (), {})
+            else:
+                returned = hook(submodule, ())
+            if returned is not None:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"a {type(submodule).__name__} forward-pre hook returned a replacement "
+                    "input, which moe_ep_chunk_overlap cannot honour: it never calls forward"
+                )
+    experts._ensure_main_grad_for_fused_impl()
+
+
+def expert_weight_parameters(
+    experts: torch.nn.Module, num_local_experts: int
+) -> tuple[torch.nn.Parameter, ...]:
+    return tuple(
+        linear.get_parameter(f"weight{index}")
+        for linear in (experts.linear_fc1, experts.linear_fc2)
+        for index in range(num_local_experts)
+    )
+
+
+def check_fused_grouped_mlp(fc1_op, activation_op, fc2_op) -> None:
+    """Raise unless TE will fuse this triple and honour its recompute; both failures are silent."""
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.ops.fused.grouped_mlp import (
+        GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMMGLU,
+        GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMMUnary,
+        ScaledSReLU,
+        _grouped_gemm_dsrelu_backward_supported,
+        _nvidia_cudnn_frontend_supports_wgrad,
+        is_glu_activation,
+        validate_grouped_mlp_dims,
+    )
+
+    fused = GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMMGLU if is_glu_activation(activation_op) else GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMMUnary
+    if not fused.is_supported():
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"TransformerEngine did not register {fused.__name__}, so this path would silently "
+            "run three unfused ops. Export NVTE_CUTEDSL_FUSED_GROUPED_MLP=1 BEFORE importing TE."
+        )
+
+    validate_grouped_mlp_dims(fc1_op, activation_op, fc2_op)
+
+    if activation_op.activation_recompute_in_mlp and not (
+        isinstance(activation_op, ScaledSReLU)
+        and _grouped_gemm_dsrelu_backward_supported()
+        and _nvidia_cudnn_frontend_supports_wgrad()
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "'moe_act' in recompute_modules asks TE for in-MLP recompute it will not do: "
+            f"op={type(activation_op).__name__} dsrelu={_grouped_gemm_dsrelu_backward_supported()}"
+            f" fe_wgrad={_nvidia_cudnn_frontend_supports_wgrad()}; TE saves the FC2 input anyway"
+        )
+
+
+def build_activation_op(
+    config: TransformerConfig, *, activation_recompute: bool
+) -> torch.nn.Module:
+    """The TE activation this config asks for; only these three take the routing probability."""
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch import ops as te_ops
+
+    glu = {"glu_interleave_size": config.moe_mlp_glu_interleave_size}
+    clamp = config.activation_func_clamp_value
+
+    recompute = {"activation_recompute_in_mlp": activation_recompute}
+    if config.gated_linear_unit and config.activation_func == F.silu:
+        if clamp is None:
+            return te_ops.ScaledSwiGLU(**glu, **recompute)
+        return te_ops.ScaledClampedQGeGLU(
+            **glu, **recompute, alpha=1.0, limit=clamp, glu_linear_offset=0.0
+        )
+    if config.gated_linear_unit and config.activation_func == quick_gelu:
+        return te_ops.ScaledClampedQGeGLU(
+            **glu, **recompute, **({} if clamp is None else {"limit": clamp})
+        )
+    if not config.gated_linear_unit and config.activation_func == squared_relu:
+        return te_ops.ScaledSReLU(**recompute)
+    raise RuntimeError(
+        f"cannot fold the routing probability into {config.activation_func} "
+        f"(gated={config.gated_linear_unit}): only ScaledSwiGLU/ScaledClampedQGeGLU/ScaledSReLU"
+    )
+
+
+def build_expert_ops(
+    config: _MoEEPChunkOverlapConfig, experts: torch.nn.Module
+) -> tuple[torch.nn.Module, torch.nn.Module, torch.nn.Module]:
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch import ops as te_ops
+
+    num_local_experts = config.num_local_experts
+    params = expert_weight_parameters(experts, num_local_experts)
+    ops = []
+
+    for weights, linear in (
+        (params[:num_local_experts], experts.linear_fc1),
+        (params[num_local_experts:], experts.linear_fc2),
+    ):
+        op = te_ops.GroupedLinear(
+            linear.num_gemms,
+            linear.in_features,
+            linear.out_features,
+            bias=False,
+            device="meta",
+            dtype=weights[0].dtype,
+            accumulate_into_main_grad=True,
+            delay_wgrad_compute=True,
+        )
+        for index, weight in enumerate(weights):
+            op.register_parameter(f"weight{index}", weight)
+        ops.append(op)
+    fc1_op, fc2_op = ops
+
+    activation_op = build_activation_op(
+        experts.config, activation_recompute=experts.activation_recompute
+    )
+    check_fused_grouped_mlp(fc1_op, activation_op, fc2_op)
+    return te_ops.Sequential(fc1_op, activation_op, fc2_op), fc1_op, fc2_op
+
+
+def expert_row_counts(cumulative_recv_tokens: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Derive TE's per-expert split sizes from the transport's cumulative receive counts."""
+    alignment = EXPERT_ALIGNMENT_TO_GROUPED_GEMM
+    ends = ((cumulative_recv_tokens.to(torch.int64) + (alignment - 1)) // alignment) * alignment
+    starts = torch.cat([ends.new_zeros(1), ends[:-1]])
+    return ends - starts
+
+
+def autocast_recipe() -> object:
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.quantization import FP8GlobalStateManager
+
+    if not FP8GlobalStateManager.is_fp8_enabled():
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "no live MXFP8 quantization autocast around this layer's forward. FIX: launch with "
+            "the mxfp8 recipe, or clear first_last_layers_bf16 (fp8_utils.py:714-724) here"
+        )
+    recipe = FP8GlobalStateManager.get_fp8_recipe()
+    if not recipe.mxfp8():
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"the live autocast carries a {type(recipe).__name__} recipe; this path implements "
+            "MXFP8 block scaling only, and going ahead would silently discard the configured one"
+        )
+    return recipe
+
+
+def _needs_backward_gather(shadow) -> bool:
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.ops._common import is_quantized_tensor
+
+    if not is_quantized_tensor(shadow):
+        return False
+    return shadow._columnwise_data is None
+
+
+def _install_backward_gather(op, weights) -> int:
+    """Rematerialize an EGTP expert group COLUMNWISE for the backward."""
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.cpu_offload import mark_not_offload
+
+    num_local_experts = len(weights)
+    shadows = [op.__dict__.get(f"weight{index}") for index in range(num_local_experts)]
+    stale = [i for i, s in enumerate(shadows) if s is not None and _needs_backward_gather(s)]
+    if not stale:
+        return 0
+
+    bwd_weights = list(weights[0].materialize_group_for_backward())
+
+    for index in stale:
+        shadow, bwd_w = shadows[index], bwd_weights[index]
+        columnwise_data = getattr(bwd_w, "_columnwise_data", None)
+        columnwise_scale = getattr(bwd_w, "_columnwise_scale_inv", None)
+
+        mark_not_offload(bwd_w)
+        shadow._columnwise_data = columnwise_data
+        shadow._columnwise_scale_inv = columnwise_scale
+
+        shadow._with_gemm_swizzled_scales = getattr(bwd_w, "_with_gemm_swizzled_scales", False)
+
+        shadow._rowwise_data = None
+        shadow._rowwise_scale_inv = None
+
+    op.__dict__["_egtp_bwd_weight_group"] = bwd_weights
+    return len(bwd_weights)
+
+
+def _attach_wgrad_accumulator(op, index: int, param) -> None:
+    """Give one EGTP expert's weight slot a full-sized ZEROED wgrad accumulator as ``main_grad``."""
+    accumulator = param.get_wgrad_tensor()
+    accumulator.zero_()
+    op.__dict__[f"weight{index}"].main_grad = accumulator
+
+
+def run_expert_forward(
+    runtime: MoEEPChunkOverlapRuntime,
+    *,
+    recv_x: torch.Tensor,
+    received_topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    cumulative_recv_tokens: torch.Tensor,
+    dispatch_handle: object,
+    stream: torch.cuda.Stream,
+    offload: bool,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, CachedForwardChunkActivation]:
+    """Run FC1, the weighted squared ReLU and FC2 as one fused op, inside its own offload group."""
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch import autocast
+
+    ops = runtime.expert_ops()
+    split_sizes = expert_row_counts(cumulative_recv_tokens)
+    dispatched_tokens = recv_x.detach().requires_grad_(True)
+    routing_probs = received_topk_weights.detach().reshape(-1).requires_grad_(True)
+    offload_group = off_interface(offload, dispatched_tokens, "fused_group_mlp")
+
+    with (
+        torch.cuda.stream(stream),
+        torch.enable_grad(),
+        autocast(enabled=True, recipe=autocast_recipe()),
+    ):
+        with offload_group as group_input:
+            fc2_output = ops(group_input, split_sizes, routing_probs, split_sizes)
+        fc2_output = offload_group.group_offload(fc2_output)
+        transport_output = fc2_output.detach()
+    return transport_output, CachedForwardChunkActivation(
+        dispatched_tokens=dispatched_tokens,
+        routing_probs=routing_probs,
+        fc2_output=fc2_output,
+        dispatch_handle=dispatch_handle,
+    )
+
+
+def run_expert_backward(
+    *, recv_x: torch.Tensor, saved: CachedForwardChunkActivation, stream: torch.cuda.Stream
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Run the dgrad pair; the weight gradients stay parked for ``run_chunk_wgrad`` to drain."""
+
+    saved.dispatched_tokens.record_stream(stream)
+    saved.routing_probs.record_stream(stream)
+    saved.fc2_output.record_stream(stream)
+
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        grad_input, grad_probs = torch.autograd.grad(
+            outputs=(saved.fc2_output,),
+            inputs=(saved.dispatched_tokens, saved.routing_probs),
+            grad_outputs=(recv_x,),
+            retain_graph=False,
+        )
+    return grad_input, grad_probs
+
+
+class _MoEEPChunkOverlapFunction(torch.autograd.Function):
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(
+        ctx,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        runtime: "MoEEPChunkOverlapRuntime",
+        *expert_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        output, saved_fwd = runtime.moe_forward(
+            hidden_states,
+            topk_indices,
+            topk_weights,
+            offload=runtime._experts.offload_fused_group_mlp,
+        )
+        ctx.runtime = runtime
+        ctx.saved_fwd = saved_fwd
+        ctx.num_expert_weights = len(expert_weights)
+
+        ctx.set_materialize_grads(False)
+        return output
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @once_differentiable
+    def backward(ctx, grad_output: torch.Tensor | None):
+        runtime = ctx.runtime
+        saved_fwd = ctx.saved_fwd
+
+        ctx.runtime = None
+        ctx.saved_fwd = None
+
+        grad_hidden_states, grad_topk_weights, wgrad_placeholders = runtime.moe_backward(
+            saved_fwd, grad_output
+        )
+        return (grad_hidden_states, None, grad_topk_weights, None) + wgrad_placeholders
+
+
+class MoEEPChunkOverlapRuntime:
+    """One layer's transport, compiled GEMMs and borrowed expert parameters."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        num_experts: int,
+        router_topk: int,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        ffn_hidden_size: int,
+        num_chunks: int,
+        num_comm_SMs: int,
+        experts: torch.nn.Module,
+        tp_ep_group: torch.distributed.ProcessGroup,
+        num_local_experts: int,
+        transport_type: MoEEPTransportType = MoEEPTransportType.HYBRID_EP,
+    ) -> None:
+        if tp_ep_group is None:
+            raise ValueError("moe_ep_chunk_overlap requires pg_collection.tp_ep, but it is None")
+
+        self._experts = experts
+        self._tp_ep_group = tp_ep_group
+        self._num_local_experts = num_local_experts
+
+        self._num_experts: int = num_experts
+        self._router_topk: int = router_topk
+        self._hidden_size: int = hidden_size
+        self._ffn_hidden_size: int = ffn_hidden_size
+        self._num_chunks: int = num_chunks
+        self._num_comm_SMs: int = num_comm_SMs
+        self._transport_type: MoEEPTransportType = transport_type
+
+        self.config: _MoEEPChunkOverlapConfig | None = None
+        self.device: torch.device | None = None
+        self.expert_params: tuple[torch.nn.Parameter, ...] | None = None
+        self._transport: MoEEPTransport | None = None
+        self.comm_stream: torch.cuda.Stream | None = None
+
+        self._ops: torch.nn.Module | None = None
+        self._fc1_op: torch.nn.Module | None = None
+        self._fc2_op: torch.nn.Module | None = None
+
+    def forward(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, dense_probs: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, None]:
+        input_shape = hidden_states.shape
+        flat_hidden = hidden_states.view(-1, self._hidden_size)
+

+    return tuple(base + (1 if index < remainder else 0) for index in range(num_chunks))

+    saved.dispatched_tokens.record_stream(stream)

+            inputs=(saved.dispatched_tokens, saved.routing_probs),

+
+    forward   (ascending)    FC1(c) -> FC2(c)   ||   Dispatch(c+1) or Combine(c-1)
+    backward  (descending)   dgrad(c)           ||   Dispatch(c-1) or Combine(c+1)

+def balanced_chunk_sizes(num_tokens: int, num_chunks: int) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    """Split ``num_tokens`` into ``num_chunks`` sizes that differ by at most one."""
+    base, remainder = divmod(num_tokens, num_chunks)
+    return tuple(base + (1 if index < remainder else 0) for index in range(num_chunks))
+
+
+def chunk_offsets(chunk_sizes: tuple[int, ...]) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    """Exclusive prefix sums of ``chunk_sizes``, with the total appended."""
+    offsets = [0]
+    for size in chunk_sizes:
+        offsets.append(offsets[-1] + size)
+    return tuple(offsets)
+
+

+    num_local_tokens: int
+    hidden_size: int
+    ffn_hidden_size: int

+    num_token_chunks: int

+    base, remainder = divmod(num_tokens, num_chunks)
+    return tuple(base + (1 if index < remainder else 0) for index in range(num_chunks))
+
+
+def chunk_offsets(chunk_sizes: tuple[int, ...]) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    """Exclusive prefix sums of ``chunk_sizes``, with the total appended."""
+    offsets = [0]
+    for size in chunk_sizes:
+        offsets.append(offsets[-1] + size)
+    return tuple(offsets)

+    @property

+        return -(-self.num_local_tokens // self.num_token_chunks)

+        """One chunk's receive capacity, rounded up to the grouped-GEMM alignment."""
+        num_local_experts = self.num_local_experts

+            self.router_topk, num_local_experts
+        ) + num_local_experts * (EXPERT_ALIGNMENT_TO_GROUPED_GEMM - 1)

+    for submodule in chain(experts.linear_fc1.modules(), experts.linear_fc2.modules()):
+        for hook_id, hook in list(submodule._forward_pre_hooks.items()):
+            if hook_id in submodule._forward_pre_hooks_with_kwargs:
+                returned = hook(submodule, (), {})
+            else:
+                returned = hook(submodule, ())
+            if returned is not None:

+        for linear in (experts.linear_fc1, experts.linear_fc2)

+        GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMMGLU,
+        GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMMUnary,
+        ScaledSReLU,
+        _grouped_gemm_dsrelu_backward_supported,
+        _nvidia_cudnn_frontend_supports_wgrad,

+            f"TransformerEngine did not register {fused.__name__}, so this path would silently "
+            "run three unfused ops. TE before the split_alignment API also needs "
+            "NVTE_CUTEDSL_FUSED_GROUPED_MLP=1 exported BEFORE importing TE."

+        isinstance(activation_op, ScaledSReLU)

+            "'moe_act' in recompute_modules asks TE for in-MLP recompute it will not do: "
+            f"op={type(activation_op).__name__} dsrelu={_grouped_gemm_dsrelu_backward_supported()}"

+def autocast_recipe() -> object:
+    """The quantization recipe of the live autocast; raises when no autocast surrounds it."""
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.quantization import FP8GlobalStateManager

+    if not FP8GlobalStateManager.is_fp8_enabled():
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "no live MXFP8 quantization autocast around this layer's forward. FIX: launch with "
+            "the mxfp8 recipe, or clear first_last_layers_bf16 (fp8_utils.py:714-724) here"
+        )
+    recipe = FP8GlobalStateManager.get_fp8_recipe()
+    if not recipe.mxfp8():
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"the live autocast carries a {type(recipe).__name__} recipe; this path implements "
+            "MXFP8 block scaling only, and going ahead would silently discard the configured one"

+    return shadow._columnwise_data is None

+    """Rematerialize an EGTP expert group COLUMNWISE for the backward."""
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.cpu_offload import mark_not_offload
+
+    num_local_experts = len(weights)
+    shadows = [op.__dict__.get(f"weight{index}") for index in range(num_local_experts)]
+    stale = [i for i, s in enumerate(shadows) if s is not None and _needs_backward_gather(s)]
+    if not stale:
+        return 0
+
+    bwd_weights = list(weights[0].materialize_group_for_backward())
+
+    for index in stale:
+        shadow, bwd_w = shadows[index], bwd_weights[index]
+        columnwise_data = getattr(bwd_w, "_columnwise_data", None)
+        columnwise_scale = getattr(bwd_w, "_columnwise_scale_inv", None)
+
+        mark_not_offload(bwd_w)
+        shadow._columnwise_data = columnwise_data
+        shadow._columnwise_scale_inv = columnwise_scale
+
+        shadow._with_gemm_swizzled_scales = getattr(bwd_w, "_with_gemm_swizzled_scales", False)
+
+        shadow._rowwise_data = None
+        shadow._rowwise_scale_inv = None

+    op.__dict__["_egtp_bwd_weight_group"] = bwd_weights
+    return len(bwd_weights)

+def _attach_wgrad_accumulator(op, index: int, param) -> None:
+    """Give one EGTP expert's weight slot a full-sized ZEROED wgrad accumulator as ``main_grad``."""
+    accumulator = param.get_wgrad_tensor()
+    accumulator.zero_()
+    op.__dict__[f"weight{index}"].main_grad = accumulator

+def run_expert_forward(
+    runtime: MoEEPChunkOverlapRuntime, *, dispatched: DispatchedChunk, stream: torch.cuda.Stream

+    """Run one chunk through the experts' OWN fused FC1 / activation / FC2."""
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch import autocast
+
+    runtime.expert_ops()
+    split_sizes = dispatched.split_sizes
+    dispatched_tokens = dispatched.recv_x.detach().requires_grad_(True)
+    routing_probs = dispatched.recv_probs.detach().reshape(-1).requires_grad_(True)
+
+    # The EXPERTS run the chunk, exactly as the trunk runs a whole microbatch: their
+    # `_fused_forward` owns the offload group, the padding decision and the op_kwargs.
+    with (
+        torch.cuda.stream(stream),
+        torch.enable_grad(),
+        autocast(enabled=True, recipe=autocast_recipe()),
+    ):

+            raise RuntimeError("moe_ep_chunk_overlap does not support an expert FC2 bias")
+        transport_output = fc2_output.detach()
+    return transport_output, CachedForwardChunkActivation(
+        dispatched_tokens=dispatched_tokens,
+        routing_probs=routing_probs,
+        fc2_output=fc2_output,
+        dispatch_graph=dispatched.graph,
+    )
+
+
+def run_expert_backward(
+    *, recv_x: torch.Tensor, saved: CachedForwardChunkActivation, stream: torch.cuda.Stream
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Run the dgrad pair; the weight gradients stay parked for ``run_chunk_wgrad`` to drain."""
+
+    saved.dispatched_tokens.record_stream(stream)
+    saved.routing_probs.record_stream(stream)
+    saved.fc2_output.record_stream(stream)
+
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        grad_input, grad_probs = torch.autograd.grad(
+            outputs=(saved.fc2_output,),
+            inputs=(saved.dispatched_tokens, saved.routing_probs),
+            grad_outputs=(recv_x,),
+            retain_graph=False,
+        )
+    return grad_input, grad_probs

+class _MoEEPChunkOverlapFunction(torch.autograd.Function):

+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(
+        ctx,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        routing_map: torch.Tensor,
+        dense_probs: torch.Tensor,
+        runtime: "MoEEPChunkOverlapRuntime",

+        """Run the chunked forward, saving each chunk's activation for the backward."""
+        output, saved_fwd = runtime.moe_forward(hidden_states, routing_map, dense_probs)
+        ctx.runtime = runtime
+        ctx.saved_fwd = saved_fwd
+        ctx.num_expert_weights = len(expert_weights)
+
+        ctx.set_materialize_grads(False)
+        return output
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @once_differentiable
+    def backward(ctx, grad_output: torch.Tensor | None):
+        """Run the chunked backward, returning grads for the inputs and expert weights."""
+        runtime = ctx.runtime
+        saved_fwd = ctx.saved_fwd
+
+        ctx.runtime = None
+        ctx.saved_fwd = None
+
+        grad_hidden_states, grad_dense_probs, wgrad_placeholders = runtime.moe_backward(
+            saved_fwd, grad_output
+        )
+        return (grad_hidden_states, None, grad_dense_probs, None) + wgrad_placeholders

+        if self.num_local_tokens < self.num_token_chunks:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"num_local_tokens ({self.num_local_tokens}) must be >= num_token_chunks "
+                f"({self.num_token_chunks}); an empty chunk is not a supported dispatch shape"
+            )
+
+    @property
+    def chunk_sizes(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        """Token count of each of this rank's chunks."""
+        return balanced_chunk_sizes(self.num_local_tokens, self.num_token_chunks)
+
+    @property
+    def chunk_offsets(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        """Row offset of each of this rank's chunks, with the total appended."""
+        return chunk_offsets(self.chunk_sizes)
+
+    @property
+    def largest_token_chunk_size(self) -> int:
+        """Rows in the largest chunk; every per-chunk buffer is sized for this one."""
+        return -(-self.num_local_tokens // self.num_token_chunks)
+
+    @property
+    def max_num_expanded_tokens_per_chunk(self) -> int:
+        """One chunk's receive capacity, rounded up to the grouped-GEMM alignment."""
+        num_local_experts = self.num_local_experts
+        rows = self.world_size * self.largest_token_chunk_size * min(
+            self.router_topk, num_local_experts
+        ) + num_local_experts * (EXPERT_ALIGNMENT_TO_GROUPED_GEMM - 1)
+        return -(-rows // EXPERT_ALIGNMENT_TO_GROUPED_GEMM) * EXPERT_ALIGNMENT_TO_GROUPED_GEMM
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DispatchedChunk:
+    """One dispatch's receive, and the autograd node that produced it."""
+
+    recv_x: torch.Tensor
+    recv_probs: torch.Tensor
+    #: Alignment-padded received rows per LOCAL expert, straight from the dispatch manager.
+    split_sizes: torch.Tensor
+    #: ``(inputs, outputs)`` of the dispatch node. Differentiating it IS the combine adjoint,
+    #: so this path never spells one out: it is whatever the flex backend's own backward does.
+    graph: tuple[tuple[torch.Tensor, ...], tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]]
+
+
+@dataclass
+class CachedForwardChunkActivation:
+    """What one chunk's forward leaves behind for its backward."""
+
+    dispatched_tokens: torch.Tensor
+    routing_probs: torch.Tensor
+    fc2_output: torch.Tensor
+    #: The dispatch node, carried from the forward; see :class:`DispatchedChunk`.
+    dispatch_graph: tuple[tuple[torch.Tensor, ...], tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]]
+    #: ``(input, output)`` of the combine node, filled once the combine has run.
+    #: Differentiating it is the dispatch adjoint.
+    combine_graph: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None
+
+
+def ensure_expert_parameters_ready(experts: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Fire the expert linears' forward-pre hooks; skipping silently desyncs the DP all-gather."""
+    for submodule in chain(experts.linear_fc1.modules(), experts.linear_fc2.modules()):
+        for hook_id, hook in list(submodule._forward_pre_hooks.items()):
+            if hook_id in submodule._forward_pre_hooks_with_kwargs:
+                returned = hook(submodule, (), {})
+            else:
+                returned = hook(submodule, ())
+            if returned is not None:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"a {type(submodule).__name__} forward-pre hook returned a replacement "
+                    "input, which moe_ep_chunk_overlap cannot honour: it never calls forward"
+                )
+    experts._ensure_main_grad_for_fused_impl()
+
+
+def expert_weight_parameters(
+    experts: torch.nn.Module, num_local_experts: int
+) -> tuple[torch.nn.Parameter, ...]:
+    """Every expert ``weightN`` parameter, fc1's before fc2's."""
+    return tuple(
+        linear.get_parameter(f"weight{index}")
+        for linear in (experts.linear_fc1, experts.linear_fc2)
+        for index in range(num_local_experts)
+    )
+
+
+def check_fused_grouped_mlp(fc1_op, activation_op, fc2_op) -> None:
+    """Raise unless TE will fuse this triple and honour its recompute; both failures are silent."""
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.ops.fused.grouped_mlp import (
+        GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMMGLU,
+        GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMMUnary,
+        ScaledSReLU,
+        _grouped_gemm_dsrelu_backward_supported,
+        _nvidia_cudnn_frontend_supports_wgrad,
+        is_glu_activation,
+        validate_grouped_mlp_dims,
+    )
+
+    fused = GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMMGLU if is_glu_activation(activation_op) else GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMMUnary
+    if not fused.is_supported():
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"TransformerEngine did not register {fused.__name__}, so this path would silently "
+            "run three unfused ops. TE before the split_alignment API also needs "
+            "NVTE_CUTEDSL_FUSED_GROUPED_MLP=1 exported BEFORE importing TE."
+        )
+
+    validate_grouped_mlp_dims(fc1_op, activation_op, fc2_op)
+
+    if activation_op.activation_recompute_in_mlp and not (
+        isinstance(activation_op, ScaledSReLU)
+        and _grouped_gemm_dsrelu_backward_supported()
+        and _nvidia_cudnn_frontend_supports_wgrad()
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "'moe_act' in recompute_modules asks TE for in-MLP recompute it will not do: "
+            f"op={type(activation_op).__name__} dsrelu={_grouped_gemm_dsrelu_backward_supported()}"
+            f" fe_wgrad={_nvidia_cudnn_frontend_supports_wgrad()}; TE saves the FC2 input anyway"
+        )
+
+
+def check_dispatch_capacity(payload: torch.Tensor, capacity: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Hold the dispatch width fixed: a varying one is what a CUDA-graph capture cannot serve."""
+    if payload.shape[0] != capacity:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"a dispatch returned {payload.shape[0]} expanded rows, not the {capacity} the "
+            "expert GEMMs are compiled for: the pinned permuted-token count has drifted"
+        )
+    return payload
+
+
+def autocast_recipe() -> object:
+    """The quantization recipe of the live autocast; raises when no autocast surrounds it."""
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.quantization import FP8GlobalStateManager
+
+    if not FP8GlobalStateManager.is_fp8_enabled():
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "no live MXFP8 quantization autocast around this layer's forward. FIX: launch with "
+            "the mxfp8 recipe, or clear first_last_layers_bf16 (fp8_utils.py:714-724) here"
+        )
+    recipe = FP8GlobalStateManager.get_fp8_recipe()
+    if not recipe.mxfp8():
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"the live autocast carries a {type(recipe).__name__} recipe; this path implements "
+            "MXFP8 block scaling only, and going ahead would silently discard the configured one"
+        )
+    return recipe
+
+
+def _needs_backward_gather(shadow) -> bool:
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.ops._common import is_quantized_tensor
+
+    if not is_quantized_tensor(shadow):
+        return False
+    return shadow._columnwise_data is None
+
+
+def _install_backward_gather(op, weights) -> int:
+    """Rematerialize an EGTP expert group COLUMNWISE for the backward."""
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch.cpu_offload import mark_not_offload
+
+    num_local_experts = len(weights)
+    shadows = [op.__dict__.get(f"weight{index}") for index in range(num_local_experts)]
+    stale = [i for i, s in enumerate(shadows) if s is not None and _needs_backward_gather(s)]
+    if not stale:
+        return 0
+
+    bwd_weights = list(weights[0].materialize_group_for_backward())
+
+    for index in stale:
+        shadow, bwd_w = shadows[index], bwd_weights[index]
+        columnwise_data = getattr(bwd_w, "_columnwise_data", None)
+        columnwise_scale = getattr(bwd_w, "_columnwise_scale_inv", None)
+
+        mark_not_offload(bwd_w)
+        shadow._columnwise_data = columnwise_data
+        shadow._columnwise_scale_inv = columnwise_scale
+
+        shadow._with_gemm_swizzled_scales = getattr(bwd_w, "_with_gemm_swizzled_scales", False)
+
+        shadow._rowwise_data = None
+        shadow._rowwise_scale_inv = None
+
+    op.__dict__["_egtp_bwd_weight_group"] = bwd_weights
+    return len(bwd_weights)
+
+
+def _attach_wgrad_accumulator(op, index: int, param) -> None:
+    """Give one EGTP expert's weight slot a full-sized ZEROED wgrad accumulator as ``main_grad``."""
+    accumulator = param.get_wgrad_tensor()
+    accumulator.zero_()
+    op.__dict__[f"weight{index}"].main_grad = accumulator
+
+
+def run_expert_forward(
+    runtime: MoEEPChunkOverlapRuntime, *, dispatched: DispatchedChunk, stream: torch.cuda.Stream
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, CachedForwardChunkActivation]:
+    """Run one chunk through the experts' OWN fused FC1 / activation / FC2."""
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch import autocast
+
+    runtime.expert_ops()
+    split_sizes = dispatched.split_sizes
+    dispatched_tokens = dispatched.recv_x.detach().requires_grad_(True)
+    routing_probs = dispatched.recv_probs.detach().reshape(-1).requires_grad_(True)
+
+    # The EXPERTS run the chunk, exactly as the trunk runs a whole microbatch: their
+    # `_fused_forward` owns the offload group, the padding decision and the op_kwargs.
+    with (
+        torch.cuda.stream(stream),
+        torch.enable_grad(),
+        autocast(enabled=True, recipe=autocast_recipe()),
+    ):
+        fc2_output, fc2_bias = runtime._experts(dispatched_tokens, split_sizes, routing_probs)
+        if fc2_bias is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("moe_ep_chunk_overlap does not support an expert FC2 bias")
+        transport_output = fc2_output.detach()
+    return transport_output, CachedForwardChunkActivation(
+        dispatched_tokens=dispatched_tokens,
+        routing_probs=routing_probs,
+        fc2_output=fc2_output,
+        dispatch_graph=dispatched.graph,
+    )
+
+
+def run_expert_backward(
+    *, recv_x: torch.Tensor, saved: CachedForwardChunkActivation, stream: torch.cuda.Stream
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Run the dgrad pair; the weight gradients stay parked for ``run_chunk_wgrad`` to drain."""
+
+    saved.dispatched_tokens.record_stream(stream)
+    saved.routing_probs.record_stream(stream)
+    saved.fc2_output.record_stream(stream)
+
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        grad_input, grad_probs = torch.autograd.grad(
+            outputs=(saved.fc2_output,),
+            inputs=(saved.dispatched_tokens, saved.routing_probs),
+            grad_outputs=(recv_x,),
+            retain_graph=False,
+        )
+    return grad_input, grad_probs
+
+
+class _MoEEPChunkOverlapFunction(torch.autograd.Function):
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(
+        ctx,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        routing_map: torch.Tensor,
+        dense_probs: torch.Tensor,
+        runtime: "MoEEPChunkOverlapRuntime",
+        *expert_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Run the chunked forward, saving each chunk's activation for the backward."""
+        output, saved_fwd = runtime.moe_forward(hidden_states, routing_map, dense_probs)
+        ctx.runtime = runtime
+        ctx.saved_fwd = saved_fwd
+        ctx.num_expert_weights = len(expert_weights)
+
+        ctx.set_materialize_grads(False)
+        return output
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @once_differentiable
+    def backward(ctx, grad_output: torch.Tensor | None):
+        """Run the chunked backward, returning grads for the inputs and expert weights."""
+        runtime = ctx.runtime
+        saved_fwd = ctx.saved_fwd
+
+        ctx.runtime = None
+        ctx.saved_fwd = None
+
+        grad_hidden_states, grad_dense_probs, wgrad_placeholders = runtime.moe_backward(
+            saved_fwd, grad_output
+        )
+        return (grad_hidden_states, None, grad_dense_probs, None) + wgrad_placeholders
+
+
+class MoEEPChunkOverlapRuntime:
+    """One layer's transport, compiled GEMMs and borrowed expert parameters."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        num_experts: int,
+        router_topk: int,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        ffn_hidden_size: int,
+        num_chunks: int,
+        num_comm_SMs: int | None,
+        experts: torch.nn.Module,
+        tp_ep_group: torch.distributed.ProcessGroup,
+        num_local_experts: int,
+        managers: Sequence[object],
+    ) -> None:
+        if tp_ep_group is None:
+            raise ValueError("moe_ep_chunk_overlap requires pg_collection.tp_ep, but it is None")
+
+        self._experts = experts
+        self._tp_ep_group = tp_ep_group
+        self._num_local_experts = num_local_experts
+
+        self._num_experts: int = num_experts
+        self._router_topk: int = router_topk
+        self._hidden_size: int = hidden_size
+        self._ffn_hidden_size: int = ffn_hidden_size
+        self._num_chunks: int = num_chunks
+        self._num_comm_SMs: int | None = num_comm_SMs
+        if len(managers) != num_chunks:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"moe_ep_chunk_overlap needs one dispatch manager per token chunk, got "
+                f"{len(managers)} for {num_chunks} chunks; chunk c\'s combine runs while "
+                "c+1\'s dispatch is still in flight, so they cannot share staging"
+            )
+        self._managers: tuple[object, ...] = tuple(managers)
+
+        self.config: _MoEEPChunkOverlapConfig | None = None
+        self.device: torch.device | None = None
+        self.expert_params: tuple[torch.nn.Parameter, ...] | None = None
+        self.comm_stream: torch.cuda.Stream | None = None
+
+        self._ops: torch.nn.Module | None = None
+        self._fc1_op: torch.nn.Module | None = None
+        self._fc2_op: torch.nn.Module | None = None
+
+    def forward(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, dense_probs: torch.Tensor, routing_map: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, None]:
+        """Run the overlap path for one layer, returning ``(output, bias)`` like MoELayer."""
+        input_shape = hidden_states.shape
+        flat_hidden = hidden_states.view(-1, self._hidden_size)
+        num_tokens = flat_hidden.shape[0]
+
+        self._ensure_built(flat_hidden)
+        flat_output = _MoEEPChunkOverlapFunction.apply(
+            flat_hidden,
+            routing_map.view(num_tokens, -1),
+            dense_probs.view(num_tokens, -1),
+            self,
+            *self.expert_params,
+        )
+        return flat_output.view(input_shape), None
+
+    def _ensure_built(self, flat_hidden: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        """Bind the device-side state to this batch on the first forward; a later one returns."""
+        if self.comm_stream is not None:
+            return
+
+        world_size = torch.distributed.get_world_size(self._tp_ep_group)
+        overlap_config = _MoEEPChunkOverlapConfig(
+            num_local_tokens=flat_hidden.shape[0],
+            hidden_size=self._hidden_size,
+            ffn_hidden_size=self._ffn_hidden_size,
+            num_experts=self._num_experts,
+            router_topk=self._router_topk,
+            num_token_chunks=self._num_chunks,
+            world_size=world_size,
+            num_comm_SMs=self._num_comm_SMs,
+            num_local_experts=self._num_local_experts,
+        )
+        self.config = overlap_config
+        self.device = torch.device(flat_hidden.device)
+
+        self.expert_params = expert_weight_parameters(
+            self._experts, overlap_config.num_local_experts
+        )
+        self.comm_stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=self.device)
+
+    def expert_ops(self) -> torch.nn.Module:
+        """The EXPERTS' own fused sequence, forced into existence before the first forward.
+
+        ``_fused_forward`` builds it lazily, but the quantization and EGTP steps write into the
+        ops' weight slots and run BEFORE any forward, so it has to exist by then.
+        """
+        experts = self._experts
+        # Without this the module's forward takes its UNFUSED branch, which the schedule never
+        # drains: run_chunk_wgrad would find an empty store, return early and lose every wgrad.
+        if not experts._with_fused_impl:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "the experts resolved to their unfused forward, so this schedule would run a "
+                "sequence it validated but TE never executes, and drain weight gradients that "
+                "were never deferred. _with_fused_impl is use_transformer_engine_op_fuser AND "
+                "both expert linears' will_execute_quantized(); the config gate cannot see the "
+                "second half, which is decided per linear at construction"
+            )
+        if experts._fused_ops is None:
+            # The two wgrad modes are overridden rather than required of the whole model: this
+            # schedule drains per chunk, which is not what either global flag means.
+            experts._fused_ops = (
+                experts.make_fused_ops(delay_wgrad_compute=True, accumulate_into_main_grad=True),
+            )
+        (ops,) = experts._fused_ops
+        if self._ops is None:
+            fc1_op, activation_op, fc2_op = list(ops.children())[:3]
+            check_fused_grouped_mlp(fc1_op, activation_op, fc2_op)
+            self._ops, self._fc1_op, self._fc2_op = ops, fc1_op, fc2_op
+        return self._ops
+
+    def destroy(self) -> None:
+        """Drop the dispatch managers, and with them whatever staging they own."""
+        self._managers = ()
+
+    def quantize_expert_weights(self) -> None:
+        """Quantize every expert weight ONCE per forward, not per chunk"""
+        from transformer_engine.pytorch.cpu_offload import mark_not_offload
+        from transformer_engine.pytorch.ops._common import is_quantized_tensor
+
+        recipe = autocast_recipe()
+        self.expert_ops()
+        num_local_experts = self.config.num_local_experts
+        params = self.expert_params
+        for op, weights in (
+            (self._fc1_op, params[:num_local_experts]),
+            (self._fc2_op, params[num_local_experts:]),
+        ):
+            if op.get_quantizer("forward", 1) is None:
+                op.reset_recipe_state(recipe=recipe)
+
+            is_egtp = is_gtp_param(weights[0])
+            if is_egtp:
+                source_weights = list(weights[0].materialize_group_for_forward())
+            else:
+                source_weights = list(weights)
+            for index, weight in enumerate(source_weights):
+                if is_quantized_tensor(weight):
+                    # fp8_param: TE reuses it untouched, but under EGTP the MATERIALIZED tensor must
+                    # still become the shadow
+                    if is_egtp:
+                        mark_not_offload(weight)
+                        op.__dict__[f"weight{index}"] = weight
+                    continue
+                quantizer = op.get_quantizer("forward", 2 * index + 1)
+
+                quantizer.internal = False
+                quantizer.set_usage(rowwise=True, columnwise=True)
+                quantized = quantizer(weight).requires_grad_(True)
+
+                mark_not_offload(quantized)
+                op.__dict__[f"weight{index}"] = quantized
+
+    def release_expert_weights(self) -> None:
+        """Hand the backward a weight slot whose ``main_grad`` TE accumulates into."""
+        num_local_experts = self.config.num_local_experts
+        params = self.expert_params
+        for op, weights in (
+            (self._fc1_op, params[:num_local_experts]),
+            (self._fc2_op, params[num_local_experts:]),
+        ):
+            if op is None:
+                continue
+            if is_gtp_param(weights[0]):
+                _install_backward_gather(op, list(weights))
+                for index, param in enumerate(weights):
+                    _attach_wgrad_accumulator(op, index, param)
+                continue
+            for index in range(num_local_experts):
+                op.__dict__.pop(f"weight{index}", None)
+
+    def routed_experts_compute_forward(
+        self, dispatched: DispatchedChunk
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, CachedForwardChunkActivation]:
+        """Run one chunk's expert compute on the ambient stream; return its rows and saved state."""
+        stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device)
+
+        # The three that cross from the comm stream to this one. The rest is read back there,
+        # by the combine or by the dispatch node's backward, so it never changes streams.
+        dispatched.recv_x.record_stream(stream)
+        dispatched.recv_probs.record_stream(stream)
+        dispatched.split_sizes.record_stream(stream)
+
+        return run_expert_forward(self, dispatched=dispatched, stream=stream)
+
+    def routed_experts_compute_backward(
+        self, saved: CachedForwardChunkActivation, grad_recv: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Run one chunk's dgrad pair on the ambient stream; the wgrads stay parked in TE FIFOs."""
+        stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device)
+        grad_recv.record_stream(stream)
+
+        grad_input, grad_probs = run_expert_backward(recv_x=grad_recv, saved=saved, stream=stream)
+        grad_probs = grad_probs.reshape(-1)
+        return grad_input, grad_probs
+
+    def run_chunk_wgrad(self, *, stream: torch.cuda.Stream) -> None:
+        """Flush one chunk's deferred weight-gradient GEMMs, FC2 then FC1, on ``stream``."""
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+            for label, op in (("FC2", self._fc2_op), ("FC1", self._fc1_op)):
+                op.backward_dw()
+
+    def begin_wgrad_accumulation(self) -> None:
+        """Fetch every expert parameter's ``main_grad`` and clear ``overwrite_main_grad`` if set."""
+        from transformer_engine.pytorch.ops._common import (
+            get_accumulate_flag_in_param,
+            get_main_grad_from_param,
+        )
+
+        # The wgrad is the only reader that needs the real parameters back;
+        self.release_expert_weights()
+
+        for param in self.expert_params:
+            main_grad = get_main_grad_from_param(param, op_label="moe_ep_chunk_overlap")
+            if not get_accumulate_flag_in_param(param):
+                main_grad.zero_()
+                param.overwrite_main_grad = False
+
+    def end_wgrad_accumulation(self) -> None:
+        """Reduce-scatter each EGTP expert group's accumulated wgrad ONCE, then drop the shadows."""
+        num_local_experts = self.config.num_local_experts
+        params = self.expert_params
+        # Hoisted out of the loop below: one expert_gtp_weight_remat_size governs BOTH expert
+        # linears, so either one's leader decides for both and the test cannot differ per group.
+        leader = params[0]
+        if not is_gtp_param(leader):
+            return
+
+        for op, weights in (
+            (self._fc2_op, params[num_local_experts:]),
+            (self._fc1_op, params[:num_local_experts]),
+        ):
+            if op is None:
+                continue
+            group_leader = weights[0]
+
+            wgrads = []
+            for index in range(num_local_experts):
+                shadow = op.__dict__.get(f"weight{index}")
+                wgrads.append(getattr(shadow, "main_grad", None))
+
+            # ONE reduce-scatter per group, through THAT group's own leader
+            group_leader.finalize_group_grads(wgrads)
+
+            # Restore the non-EGTP post-backward state: an empty slot.
+            for index in range(num_local_experts):
+                op.__dict__.pop(f"weight{index}", None)
+
+            op.__dict__.pop("_egtp_bwd_weight_group", None)
+
+    def moe_forward(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, routing_map: torch.Tensor, dense_probs: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, tuple[CachedForwardChunkActivation, ...]]:
+        """Forward the layer chunk by chunk, each dispatch overlapping the previous GEMM."""
+        config = self.config
+        capacity = config.max_num_expanded_tokens_per_chunk
+
+        ensure_expert_parameters_ready(self._experts)
+        self.quantize_expert_weights()
+        offsets = config.chunk_offsets
+        num_chunks = config.num_token_chunks
+
+        compute_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device)
+        comm_stream = self.comm_stream

+    def forward(

+
+                mark_not_offload(quantized)
+                op.__dict__[f"weight{index}"] = quantized
+
+    def release_expert_weights(self) -> None:
+        """Hand the backward a weight slot whose ``main_grad`` TE accumulates into."""
+        num_local_experts = self.config.num_local_experts
+        params = self.expert_params
+        for op, weights in (
+            (self._fc1_op, params[:num_local_experts]),
+            (self._fc2_op, params[num_local_experts:]),
+        ):
+            if op is None:
+                continue
+            if is_gtp_param(weights[0]):
+                _install_backward_gather(op, list(weights))
+                for index, param in enumerate(weights):
+                    _attach_wgrad_accumulator(op, index, param)
+                continue
+            for index in range(num_local_experts):
+                op.__dict__.pop(f"weight{index}", None)
+
+    def routed_experts_compute_forward(
+        self, dispatched: DispatchedChunk
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, CachedForwardChunkActivation]:
+        """Run one chunk's expert compute on the ambient stream; return its rows and saved state."""
+        stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device)
+
+        # The three that cross from the comm stream to this one. The rest is read back there,
+        # by the combine or by the dispatch node's backward, so it never changes streams.
+        dispatched.recv_x.record_stream(stream)
+        dispatched.recv_probs.record_stream(stream)
+        dispatched.split_sizes.record_stream(stream)
+
+        return run_expert_forward(self, dispatched=dispatched, stream=stream)
+
+    def routed_experts_compute_backward(
+        self, saved: CachedForwardChunkActivation, grad_recv: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Run one chunk's dgrad pair on the ambient stream; the wgrads stay parked in TE FIFOs."""
+        stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device)
+        grad_recv.record_stream(stream)
+
+        grad_input, grad_probs = run_expert_backward(recv_x=grad_recv, saved=saved, stream=stream)
+        grad_probs = grad_probs.reshape(-1)
+        return grad_input, grad_probs
+
+    def run_chunk_wgrad(self, *, stream: torch.cuda.Stream) -> None:
+        """Flush one chunk's deferred weight-gradient GEMMs, FC2 then FC1, on ``stream``."""
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+            for label, op in (("FC2", self._fc2_op), ("FC1", self._fc1_op)):
+                op.backward_dw()
+
+    def begin_wgrad_accumulation(self) -> None:
+        """Fetch every expert parameter's ``main_grad`` and clear ``overwrite_main_grad`` if set."""
+        from transformer_engine.pytorch.ops._common import (
+            get_accumulate_flag_in_param,
+            get_main_grad_from_param,
+        )
+
+        # The wgrad is the only reader that needs the real parameters back;
+        self.release_expert_weights()
+
+        for param in self.expert_params:
+            main_grad = get_main_grad_from_param(param, op_label="moe_ep_chunk_overlap")
+            if not get_accumulate_flag_in_param(param):
+                main_grad.zero_()
+                param.overwrite_main_grad = False
+
+    def end_wgrad_accumulation(self) -> None:
+        """Reduce-scatter each EGTP expert group's accumulated wgrad ONCE, then drop the shadows."""
+        num_local_experts = self.config.num_local_experts
+        params = self.expert_params
+        # Hoisted out of the loop below: one expert_gtp_weight_remat_size governs BOTH expert
+        # linears, so either one's leader decides for both and the test cannot differ per group.
+        leader = params[0]
+        if not is_gtp_param(leader):
+            return
+
+        for op, weights in (
+            (self._fc2_op, params[num_local_experts:]),
+            (self._fc1_op, params[:num_local_experts]),
+        ):
+            if op is None:
+                continue
+            group_leader = weights[0]
+
+            wgrads = []
+            for index in range(num_local_experts):
+                shadow = op.__dict__.get(f"weight{index}")
+                wgrads.append(getattr(shadow, "main_grad", None))
+
+            # ONE reduce-scatter per group, through THAT group's own leader
+            group_leader.finalize_group_grads(wgrads)
+
+            # Restore the non-EGTP post-backward state: an empty slot.
+            for index in range(num_local_experts):
+                op.__dict__.pop(f"weight{index}", None)
+
+            op.__dict__.pop("_egtp_bwd_weight_group", None)
+
+    def moe_forward(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, routing_map: torch.Tensor, dense_probs: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, tuple[CachedForwardChunkActivation, ...]]:
+        """Forward the layer chunk by chunk, each dispatch overlapping the previous GEMM."""
+        config = self.config
+        capacity = config.max_num_expanded_tokens_per_chunk
+
+        ensure_expert_parameters_ready(self._experts)
+        self.quantize_expert_weights()
+        offsets = config.chunk_offsets
+        num_chunks = config.num_token_chunks
+
+        compute_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device)
+        comm_stream = self.comm_stream
+        dispatch_ready = [torch.cuda.Event() for _ in range(num_chunks)]
+        expert_ready = [torch.cuda.Event() for _ in range(num_chunks)]
+
+        combine_done = torch.cuda.Event()
+
+        dispatched: list[DispatchedChunk | None] = [None] * num_chunks
+        saved_chunks: list[CachedForwardChunkActivation | None] = [None] * num_chunks
+        output: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+        inputs_ready = torch.cuda.Event()
+        inputs_ready.record(compute_stream)
+        comm_stream.wait_event(inputs_ready)
+
+        def issue_dispatch(c: int) -> None:
+            """Enqueue one chunk's forward dispatch on the comm stream."""
+            rows = slice(offsets[c], offsets[c + 1])
+            manager = self._managers[c]
+            with torch.cuda.stream(comm_stream):
+                # The NODE, not just its result: differentiating it is how the backward gets the
+                # combine adjoint, so the adjoint cannot drift from the trunk dispatcher's.
+                with torch.enable_grad():
+                    chunk_hidden = hidden_states[rows].detach().requires_grad_(True)
+                    chunk_probs = dense_probs[rows].detach().requires_grad_(True)
+                    manager.setup_metadata(routing_map[rows], chunk_probs)
+                    # Pin it, or the backend reads the count back out of pinned memory: the host
+                    # read a capture cannot serve. It reaches the backward via the combine's ctx.
+                    manager.num_permuted_tokens = capacity

detail.body:
- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Adds `--moe-ep-chunk-overlap` (default **off**): a token-chunked, two-stream schedule that overlaps the MoE expert-parallel all-to-alls with the expert GEMMs, replacing the routed-expert region (dispatch → FC1/act/FC2 → combine) rather than wrapping the existing token dispatcher.

:warning: This is a sizeable addition (**+1452 / −9** over 9 files). Happy to open a design issue first if @NVIDIA/mcore-oncall would prefer that — flagging it proactively per the note above.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: <!-- TODO: open a feature request and link it here; this is a new feature from an open-source contributor, so a linked issue is required -->

---

## Design

The flag is off by default and gated behind a narrow support envelope. When on, `MoELayer` routes the routed-expert region through `MoEEPChunkOverlapRuntime` instead of the flex token dispatcher:

```
forward  (ascending)   FC1(c) → FC2(c)   ||   Dispatch(c+1) or Combine(c−1)
backward (descending)  dgrad(c)          ||   Dispatch(c−1) or Combine(c+1)
                       wgrad(c)          ||   Combine(c)
```

Compute stays on the caller's ambient stream; a single comm stream carries both collectives. Every cross-stream edge is an explicit `torch.cuda.Event`. Weight gradients park in TE's per-op `WeightGradStore` (`delay_wgrad_compute=True`) and are drained inside the loop, so each chunk's wgrad runs under its own chunk's combine.

### New surface

| flag | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--moe-ep-chunk-overlap` | `False` | enable the path |
| `--moe-ep-chunk-overlap-num-chunks` | `4` | source-token chunks per microbatch |
| `--moe-ep-chunk-overlap-num-comm-sms` | `32` | SM budget for the comm stream |

Transport is selected from the **existing** `moe_flex_dispatcher_backend` (`hybridep` / `ncclep`) rather than a new flag. Public API is one name, `MoEEPChunkOverlapRuntime`.

### Files

| file | change |
|---|---|
| `moe/moe_ep_chunk_overlap/` (5 new files) | the runtime, the transport ABC, and the HybridEP / NCCL-EP transports |
| `moe/fused_a2a.py` | **+122 / −0** — purely additive: `make_hybrid_ep_buffer` and two shape-named stateless legs `hybrid_ep_dispatch_leg` / `hybrid_ep_combine_leg`. No existing trunk body is modified; the flex dispatcher's call sites are untouched. |
| `moe/moe_layer.py` | +96 / −4 — construct the runtime, route preprocess/expert/postprocess, envelope refusals |
| `transformer_config.py` | +19 — the three fields above |
| `transformer_layer.py` | +4 / −1 — `MoETransformerLayer` reads `cudagraph_attrs` with a default, since a dispatcher that never ran has not created them |

### Support envelope (refused, loudly, at construction or per-forward)

`expert_tensor_parallel_size=1`, `context_parallel_size=1`, `moe_router_dtype=fp32`, `add_bias_linear=False`, `moe_apply_probs_on_input=False`, MXFP8 (`fp8_recipe=mxfp8`, `first_last_layers_bf16=False`), activation ∈ {gated silu/quick_gelu, ungated squared_relu}, `moe_paged_stash=False`, `overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm=False`, `padding_mask=None`. `recompute_granularity='full'` and `'moe' in recompute_modules` are refused because TE's `WeightGradStore` is a FIFO with no chunk identity and a re-run forward reorders it silently. `'moe_act'` **is** supported. Expert GTP weight remat is supported at ≥ 2 local experts.

---

## Testing — what was actually measured

All on 8× B300 (sm_103), torch 2.11.0+cu130, TE 2.18/2.20, HybridEP, MXFP8, world 2–4, against this branch rebased onto `main` @ `79097b457`.

| check | result |
|---|---|
| routed-expert branch live (real `GPTModel`, fwd+bwd) | **PASS** — 482/3072 routing probs nonzero, **8/8 expert wgrads alive**, `max\|main_grad\| 1.39e-04` |
| same probe with a seeded fault | **FAIL** as required — 0/3072, 0/8 — so the check demonstrably detects |
| selective recompute (`moe_act`, ungated squared_relu) | **PASS**, 4/4 chunks, 8/8 wgrads alive |
| fine-grained activation offloading (`fused_group_mlp`) | **PASS**, 4/4 chunks, 8/8 wgrads alive |
| full-iteration CUDA graphs, no EGTP, vs eager | **96/96 bitwise** (4 ranks × 3 series × 8 iters) |
| partial CUDA graphs, ± EGTP, vs eager | **96/96 bitwise** each |

The liveness check is an **absolute magnitude** assertion, not a differential, deliberately: an earlier defect on this path zeroed every routing probability and the loss curve was indistinguishable from healthy (`6.968` vs `6.975`). A loss gate would not have caught it.

---

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [ ] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel … determinism test
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code
- [x] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

**Unticked boxes, explained rather than glossed:**

- **Unit tests** — a suite exists locally (~90 tests covering the transport seam, the envelope refusals, the EGTP flush and an activation-offload round trip) but is **not in this PR**. It needs porting into `tests/unit_tests/transformer/moe/` and will follow.
- **Functional tests** — none. No recipe references the flag yet.
- **Determinism test** — this PR adds no GPU kernel; it schedules existing TE ops and EP collectives. Happy to add one if reviewers disagree with that reading.
- **autoformat** — currently **red**, and I would rather say so than tick it: two lines exceed the 100-column limit (`moe_layer.py:362`, `:832` → pylint `C0301`) and there is trailing whitespace in `transformer_config.py` and `transformer_layer.py` that `black` will rewrite. Will be clean before this leaves draft.

+# MoE EP chunk overlap
+
+`--moe-ep-chunk-overlap` replaces the **whole** routed-expert region of a MoE layer —
+dispatch → FC1 / activation / FC2 → combine — with a token-chunked two-stream schedule, so each
+chunk's expert-parallel all-to-all overlaps the previous chunk's expert GEMMs.
+
+The GEMMs are not reimplemented: the schedule builds TE's op fuser
+(`te_ops.Sequential(GroupedLinear, activation, GroupedLinear)`) and refuses to start unless TE
+registers the fused `GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMM*` kernel, so it cannot silently fall back to three
+unfused ops. The routing probability is folded into the activation rather than applied separately.
+
+Default is off. This is training-only; under `torch.inference_mode()` the layer falls back to the
+trunk dispatcher.
+
+## Enabling it
+
+| flag | meaning |
+| --- | --- |
+| `--moe-ep-chunk-overlap` | turn the path on |
+| `--moe-ep-chunk-overlap-num-chunks` | source-token chunks per microbatch (default 4) |
+| `--moe-flex-dispatcher-backend` | must be `hybridep` or `ncclep` (see below) |
+| `--moe-flex-dispatcher-num-sms` | the communication-SM budget, shared with the flex dispatcher |
+
+## Requirements
+
+Each of these raises with a message naming the fix; none of them fails silently.
+
+* **A flex backend that can stage several dispatches at once.** One dispatch manager is built per
+  chunk, because chunk *c*'s combine runs while *c+1*'s dispatch is still in flight. `deepep` and
+  `deepepv2` stage through process-wide buffers and are refused with `NotImplementedError`; use
+  `hybridep` or `ncclep`.
+* **A TE that registers the fused grouped-MLP kernel.** `check_fused_grouped_mlp` raises if it
+  does not. On TE older than the `split_alignment` API, registration is gated on
+  `NVTE_CUTEDSL_FUSED_GROUPED_MLP=1` exported *before* TransformerEngine is imported; newer TE
+  matches the fusion itself and ignores the variable.
+* **An MXFP8 quantization autocast around the layer's forward.** This path implements MXFP8 block
+  scaling only. No live autocast, or a non-MXFP8 recipe, raises rather than quietly discarding the
+  configured one. If `first_last_layers_bf16` leaves a layer in bf16, that layer will raise.
+* **An activation the routing probability can fold into**: `ScaledSwiGLU`, `ScaledClampedQGeGLU` or
+  `ScaledSReLU` — i.e. gated SiLU, gated quick-GELU, or ungated squared ReLU.
+* **`pg_collection.tp_ep`** must be present.
+
+## What it refuses, and why
+
+Refused at config time (`TransformerConfig.__post_init__`):
+
+| configuration | reason |
+| --- | --- |
+| `recompute_granularity='full'` | re-running the chunked forward inside the backward reorders the wgrad FIFO silently |
+| `'moe' in recompute_modules` | same; `'moe_act'` recomputes inside TE's own backward and **is** supported |
+| `moe_paged_stash` | unsupported |
+| `expert_tensor_parallel_size > 1` | the runtime's chunk capacity is derived from an unscaled `moe_router_topk` while the dispatch manager scales it by ETP, so the dispatch would be sized short — and the pinned permuted-token count would stop `check_dispatch_capacity` seeing it. Note ETP defaults to `tensor_model_parallel_size` when unset |
+| `moe_expert_rank_capacity_factor` **and** `moe_pad_expert_input_to_capacity` | two capacity mechanisms over one dispatch |
+
+Refused at construction or at runtime:
+
+* expert GTP weight remat with fewer than 2 local experts — TE's `num_groups == 1` shortcuts read
+  past `sum(split_sizes)`, giving wrong or NaN expert wgrads with a bit-identical forward and dgrad;
+* `padding_mask`;
+* `MoELayer.backward_dw()` — the schedule drains the expert weight gradients itself, in FIFO order.
+
+Sequence packing with the `hybridep` backend is incompatible in practice, though nothing refuses
+the combination by name: `TransformerConfig` requires `moe_hybridep_pad_uneven_dispatch_inputs=True`
+for packed sequences, and that path's `setup_metadata` does an `all_reduce(...).item()` — a
+device-to-host read CUDA-graph capture cannot serve.
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Two unit-test files cover this path. Neither needs more than one GPU.
+
+**Seam tests — CPU only, no GPU required.** These pin the contract between the schedule and the
+dispatch manager: which tensors cross streams, which node is differentiated to get each adjoint,
+and which keyword surface the expert-compute step exposes.
+
+```bash
+python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/transformer/moe/test_moe_ep_overlap_backend_seam.py -q
+```
+
+Expected: `55 passed, 2 xfailed`.
+
+**Schedule tests — one GPU.** These run the chunked schedule for real against a fake dispatch
+manager, including the headline numerical gate
+`test_chunked_gradients_match_a_single_shot_autograd_reference`, which compares the chunked
+gradients against a single-shot autograd reference at 1, 2, 3 and 4 chunks.
+
+```bash
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python -m pytest \
+    tests/unit_tests/transformer/moe/test_moe_ep_chunk_overlap.py -q -p no:randomly
+```
+
+Expected: `33 passed, 5 xfailed`.
+
+### About the `xfail`s
+
+They are **strict** and self-retiring, not skips. Each one asserts a guard or a fix that does not
+exist yet and carries the evidence in its reason string — 5 on the schedule file (an eval-time
+offload gate, and four parametrizations of an upstream activation-offload reload race), 2 on the
+seam file (two absent checks in `end_wgrad_accumulation`). When the corresponding fix lands the
+test starts passing, strict-xfail turns that into a failure, and the test asks to be deleted.
+A *new* failure in either file is a real regression; an `xpass` is a fix landing.
+
+### What the unit tests do not cover
+
+They use a fake dispatch manager, so they exercise the schedule, not a real expert-parallel
+collective. Covering the real thing needs ≥2 ranks with `hybridep` or `ncclep` available, MXFP8,
+and a TE that registers the fused kernel; the cheapest end-to-end check is to take a working MoE
+training script and add `--moe-ep-chunk-overlap`, confirming the loss curve matches the run
+without it.
+
+No throughput comparison against the trunk dispatcher is published here. The schedule runs its
+GEMMs over a fixed per-chunk capacity (padding included) rather than the actual routed row count,
+and splits each microbatch into `num_chunks` smaller GEMMs, so the overlap has to pay for both
+before it wins. Measure on your own shapes, sweeping `--moe-ep-chunk-overlap-num-chunks`, before
+assuming a speedup.
